notes: Photo-licensing counterparty disclosed at cp_filing_0003 Part 5 item 6 as the source of Melania Trump's 'Use of photographic images' royalty stream ($2,501 - $5,000 Royalties for the reporting period). Getty Images Inc. is a publicly-known stock-photo licensing company, New York, NY. Registered in Fork J per §4.3 ruling as the structural anchor for the licensing relationship — Melania has no Melania-side LLC wrapper around the Getty deal (distinct from the Fork I-b Penguin Random House case where the IT WWW PUB LLC was the wrapper); the counterparty itself is the relevant disclosure surface. interest_type on the Melania family edge is 'license_counterparty' per the new enum value added in Fork J (methodology.md license_counterparty entry).
